why: The control drawing itself from the CLICK instead of from the value the store accepted -- the same convention the aim-scheme, fire-mode and haptics toggles follow, and the one `settings.ts` can actually refuse: `setMotion` drops an id outside MOTION_PREFERENCES, so a self-flipping label would show a preference that was never stored and would keep showing it until something else repainted. It also looks correct in the ordinary case, which is exactly why it needs a test rather than a reviewer.
killedBy: hud: the motion toggle (issue #289) taps the toggle and reports the NEXT preference in the cycle, from a real click at the button
